q: The Ellis semigroup E(X) of a compact topological dynamical system (X, T) is defined as:
opts: The group of homeomorphisms of X
The closure of {Tⁿ : n ∈ ℤ} in X^X with product topology
exp: E(X) is the closure of the orbit {Tⁿ} in the function space X^X under the product topology. It is a compact semigroup whose algebraic structure encodes the dynamics.
